# Moonrain: Sleep Sounds

> A free, fully offline sleep-sound mixer for iPhone, iPad and Apple silicon Macs. No account, no ads, no subscription, no in-app purchases and no tracking. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6789770084

Moonrain is made by a solo developer. Current version: 1.2 (October 2026). Requires iOS 17 or later. The App Store page is in English and Traditional Chinese; the app interface is in English.

## Features

- 28 ambient sounds: rain, ocean, forest, fire, fans, trains, and brown, pink and white noise
- Mix up to four sounds with independent volumes
- Sleep timer that fades everything out
- Relax: wind down, body scan, a breathing guide with a soft tone, and 8 whispered ASMR experiences in 3D sound
- Meditation timer with Tibetan, crystal and deep singing bowls
- Environments for work or study: coffee shop, library, park, rainy tea house and train, plus a noise lab
- Gentle wake alarm that fades in a nature sound
- Dim bedside clock with a red night light, and an OK-to-wake clock for kids
- Day Sleeper mode for people who sleep during the day
- Save mixes, share them as a link or QR code, back them up, or export one as an audio file
- Home Screen, Lock Screen and StandBy widgets, Control Center controls and Siri
- Simple Mode with large text and one big play button
- Plays all night with the screen locked
